what_likely_happened: An attacker compromised user sarah.jenkins via a targeted phishing link, subsequently performing an impossible travel login to hijack the cloud session. The adversary established an email forwarding rule to collect sensitive financial communications before mass-downloading restricted financial audit spreadsheets and payroll archives for exfiltration.

evidence.detail: User sarah.jenkins clicked link to login-microsoft-auth.secure-verify.net/reset from host WS-FIN-042.
Successful authentication from Bucharest, Romania 6 minutes after London login, indicating session compromise.
Exchange Online inbox rule created to forward financial emails to drop-audit-q4@protonmail.com.
Downloaded 48 restricted financial audit spreadsheets and payroll archives from SRV-SHARE-01 within 45 seconds.

confidence_reason: Confidence score lowered below 60% due to the presence of fragmented and missing host/user telemetry in event EVT-ROBUST-MISSING_scenario_a.
